title: Tanker report - Week 43
summary:
Clean
LR2
The TC1 75kt MEG/Japan index climbed by 92 points this week to WS1075, with the corresponding Baltic round-trip TCE rising by $28,600 to $313,200/day. For the TC20 90kt MEG/UK-Continent run, the index edged up by $168,800 to $21.51 million, corresponding to $336,400/day on Baltic round trip. The TC15 80kt Mediterranean/East index dropped by $4.24 million to $12.00 million, with the Baltic round-trip TCE falling by $57,900 to $115,100/day.

children.title: VLCC
children.summary: VLCC rates on the Baltic Exchange routes fell back further this week. The TD3C route (270,000mt Middle East Gulf/China) dropped 88 points to WS1,208.13, giving a daily round-trip TCE of $1,287,851 for the standard Baltic VLCC.

children.title: Suezmax
children.summary: In the Suezmax sector, the market was weaker again across the Baltic Exchange routes. The rate for the 130,000mt Nigeria/UK Continent voyage (TD20) fell 170 points to WS731.11, which gives a daily round-trip TCE of about $406,769.

children.title: Aframax
children.summary: In the North Sea, the rate for the 80,000mt Cross-UK Continent route (TD7) rose by 7.5 points to WS585.83, giving a daily round-trip TCE of just under $481,500 basis Hound Point to Wilhelmshaven. In the Mediterranean, the rate for 80,000mt Cross-Mediterranean (TD19) climbed about 86 points to almost the WS810 mark.
